scope: Fixed-start FP32/BF16 training-path comparisons on single/two NPU, bounded CPU FP64 and selected Attention mode diagnosis; not a throughput, trained-model-quality, 20-update or FC restoration report

summary.metadata_failures_scope: Only Timed BF16 batch_prefix and batch_prefix_reception update1: eight K.times fields per candidate

extraction_policy.first_differences_limit: original harness at most eight coordinates per category
extraction_policy.largest_errors: original top eight sorted by scaled error; not a full-tree maximum-absolute-error ranking
extraction_policy.work: separate work records compared explicitly; empty comparison.work_differences is not a work-equality claim
extraction_policy.dirty_flag: Raw source_dirty is preserved. git status in these archive directories discovers the containing main worktree. Each archived tracked blob was separately checked against its declared commit.

cross_job_isolation.interpretation: Each job compares paths at its own exact common anchor. The isolated job has a separately produced baseline warmup anchor, so it is not a bitwise three-way ablation of the original failure trajectory.
